source.note: 2026-07 audit: prior p0-p3/skill/burst values did not match GO/Amber Lv10 data at all (each hit off by a different, non-level-aligned ratio -- likely stale/hand-entered before the goCommit pointer was added). Re-derived from allStat_gen.json skillParam.Klee at commit 2937f8a80846b18c3495b7657c0bae5c78c82606, cross-checked against Amber avatar/10000029 talent[0].promote['10'] (identical). Added plunging (previously missing entirely). Renamed all hit_definitions_json keys/sections to match GO's real target paths (normal/{0,1,2}, charged/dmg, plunging/{dmg,low,high}, skill/{jumptyDumptyDmg,mineDmg}, burst/dmg) -- a leaderboard built with GO's own naming was failing with 'no hit definition' errors against the old hand-picked key names (hit1Dmg, chargedDmg, jumpyDumptyBounce (note: GO spells it 'jumpty', not 'jumpy'), sparksDmg). multKey lookups are scoped per-section by damage_evaluator_service.evaluate_build (talent_multipliers_json[path[0]]), so charged/passive1 duplicate the same p3_mult value rather than sharing one. Added passive1/dmg (A1 Sparks 'n' Splash: Charged Attack DMG with a permanent +50% Charged DMG Bonus baked in via the hit-scoped passive1dmg_dmg_ key, self_modifiers_json below; GO's asc>=1 gate and Homework-only lockBadge_mult_ are both always-true/1x for a standard built character and are not modeled separately) and constellation1/chainedReactionsDmg (C1: reuses the burst formula at 120% MV, pre-baked into chainedReactionsDmg_mult = burst p0_mult x 1.2). 2026-07-15 follow-up: the hit existed but had no documented average trigger rate, so every leaderboard rotation referencing it had to hand-guess a weight (the two existing ones, ids 330/333, both used an undocumented '9.6, empirical approximation'). Confirmed via community wiki the real mechanic: the spark-summon chance starts at 0% right after a proc/reset, +8% on every failed check, and is checked once per USE (not per hit instance) of Klee's Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst -- a pity Markov chain like Echoes of an Offering's 4pc. p_k = min(1, 0.08*(k-1)) for the k-th check since the last proc, so a miss streak is capped at 13 (guaranteed on the 14th check). E[cycle length] = sum_{k=0..13} P(fail first k) = 5.12508 checks/proc, i.e. a long-run average trigger rate of 1/E = 19.512% per check -- this is the number any rotation should multiply by its own count of NA/CA/Skill/Burst *uses* (not hit/tick instances) to get the correct chainedReactionsDmg weight. Recomputed the two existing leaderboards' weight against this (see their rotation target descriptions) rather than leaving it as an unexplained guess; not baked into self_modifiers_json because this is a discrete burst-scaled hit (crit/buffs must apply independently), not a flat stat bonus that could be pre-averaged onto another attack type the way Echoes'/Furina's fixes were. Also added self_conditional_modifiers_json.c1HexereiAtkBuff: confirmed via two independent community sources (KQM quick guide + BitTopup C0 guide) that v6.2's Hexerei rework gave C1's Hexerei-enhanced text an extra clause not in the pre-rework wiki description: 'For 12s after triggering the above effect, Klee's ATK is increased by 60%' (requires the Witch's Homework quest + >=2 Hexerei party members, same gate as Razor/Venti/Mona/Prune/Lohen's Hexerei conditionals already in this codebase) -- a manual leaderboard-admin toggle like Prune's hexereiAtkSelf, not auto-applied, since whether the team meets the Hexerei requirement is leaderboard/team-comp-specific. FLAGGED, NOT YET MODELED (v6.2 Hexerei rework, confirmed real via KQM/BitTopup/GameWith but exact mechanics unconfirmed or too involved for this pass -- needs its own follow-up): (1) the base-kit 'Boom Badge' mechanic (Klee's Witch's Eve Rite, also gated on the Homework quest + 2 Hexerei members): Normal Attack/Skill/Burst each independently grant up to 1 Boom Badge (20s duration, own timer per attack type, so up to 3 stacked), and while holding 1/2/3 badges her Charged Attack 'Boom-Boom Strike' deals 115%/130%/150% DMG -- this is very likely what GO's dismissed-as-'always 1x' lockBadge_mult_ (mentioned above re: passive1/dmg) actually represents; the badge-GAIN chance/guarantee per attack isn't confirmed by any source checked, so implementing it now would risk guessing that key number; (2) C2 rework: Elemental Skill hit now decreases opponent DEF by 23% for 10s (not previously modeled at all); (3) C4 rework: leaving the field while Sparks 'n' Splash is active (or it ending naturally) triggers an explosion for 555% ATK AoE Pyro DMG, +100% (to ~1110%) if Klee is on-field for it -- would need a new constellation4 hit; (4) C6 rework: changed from a team-wide 10% Pyro DMG bonus to a Klee-self 50% Pyro DMG bonus for 25s -- current data has no C6 buff at all, so this is a straight addition once confirmed.

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Witch's Eve Rite (Hexerei: Secret Rite, requires >=2 Hexerei party members): C1 Chained Reactions' spark-bombard effect additionally grants Klee ATK +60% for 12s after it triggers.

auto.name: Kaboom!
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Throws things that go boom when they hit things! Performs up to 3 explosive attacks, dealing <e:pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</e>.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals <e:pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</e> to opponents after a short casting time.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Gathering the power of Pyro, Klee plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <e:pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</e> upon impact with the ground.

skill.name: Jumpy Dumpty
skill.desc: Jumpy Dumpty is tons of boom-bang-fun! When thrown, Jumpy Dumpty bounces thrice, igniting and dealing AoE Pyro DMG with every bounce. On the third bounce, the bomb splits into many mines. The mines will explode upon contact with opponents, or after a short period of time, dealing AoE Pyro DMG. Starts with 2 charges. Jumpy Dumpty is Klee's good friend! She can't help but introduce him to everyone.

burst.name: Sparks 'n' Splash
burst.desc: Klee's Blazing Delight! For the duration of this ability, continuously summons Sparks 'n' Splash to attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG. The knights all believe that Klee must have a lucky star watching over her to have never been hurt by any of her own bombs...

passives.name: Pounding Surprise
passives.desc:
When Klee's Elemental Skill <k>Jumpy Dumpty</k> and Normal Attacks deal DMG, there is a 50% chance to grant her an Explosive Spark. Using her Elemental Skill <k>Jumpy Dumpty</k> or Elemental Burst <k>Sparks 'n' Splash</k> also grants 1 Explosive Spark. Klee can hold up to 3 Explosive Sparks.
While holding an Explosive Spark, Klee's Charged Attack will consume 1 Spark to perform a special stamina-free Charged Attack, Boom-Boom Strike, dealing 50% increased DMG.

<k>Hexerei: Secret Rite</k>
During the duration of Klee's Elemental Burst <k>Sparks 'n' Splash</k>, her Normal Attack sequence does not reset. If Klee holds an Explosive Spark while performing Normal Attacks, the third attack in the sequence will consume 1 Spark to unleash an additional attack equivalent to Boom-Boom Strike.

passives.name: Sparkling Burst
passives.desc: When Klee's Charged Attack results in a CRIT Hit, all party members gain 2 Elemental Energy.

passives.name: All Of My Treasures!
passives.desc: Displays the location of nearby <k>resources unique to Mondstadt</k> on the mini-map.

passives.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Sparkborne Magic
passives.desc:
After completing <k>Witch's Homework: Of Leaves That Spark</k>, Klee will become a <k>Hexerei</k> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the <k>Hexerei: Secret Rite</k> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

<k>Hexerei: Secret Rite</k>
When Klee deals DMG with Normal Attacks, Elemental Skills, or Elemental Bursts, she gains 1 Boom Badge that lasts 20s. Each type of attack can grant at most 1 Boom Badge this way, and each badge has its own independent timer. While Klee has 1/2/3 Boom Badges, her special Charged Attack Boom-Boom Strike deals 115%/130%/150% of its original DMG.

constellations.name: Chained Reactions
constellations.desc:
Attacks and Skills have a certain chance to summon sparks that bombard opponents, dealing DMG equal to 120% of <k>Sparks 'n' Splash</k>'s DMG.
For 12s after triggering the above effect, Klee's ATK is increased by 60%.

constellations.name: Explosive Frags
constellations.desc: When Klee's Elemental Skill hits an opponent, that opponent's DEF will be decreased by 23% for 10s.

constellations.name: Exquisite Compound
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Jumpy Dumpty</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Sparkly Explosion
constellations.desc: An explosion will be triggered if Klee leaves the field while <k>Sparks 'n' Splash</k> is active or when Sparks 'n' Splash ends, dealing 555% of ATK as <e:pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</e>. If Klee is on-field when the explosion occurs, its DMG will be increased by 100%.

constellations.name: Nova Burst
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Sparks 'n' Splash</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Blazing Delight
constellations.desc:
While under the effects of <k>Sparks 'n' Splash</k>, Klee will regenerate 3 Energy for all members of the party (excluding Klee) every 3s.
For 25s after <k>Sparks 'n' Splash</k> is used, all other party members will gain a 10% <e:pyro>Pyro DMG Bonus</e>, and Klee will gain a 50% <e:pyro>Pyro DMG Bonus</e>.

<k>Hexerei: Secret Rite</k>
· When Klee uses an <k>Explosive Spark</k>, there is a 50% chance it will not be consumed. Additionally, while <k>Sparks 'n' Splash</k> is active, Klee's Normal Attacks have a 40% chance on the first and second hits to consume an Explosive Spark, dealing an additional attack equivalent to Boom-Boom Strike to her opponent(s).

auto.name: Boum ! Boum !
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Une bombe qui explose au contact, ça c'est un bel objet ! Klee jette jusqu'à 3 bombes consécutives, qui infligent des <e:pyro>DGT Pyro de zone</e>.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Consomme de l'endurance pour bombarder les ennemis après un court délai et leur infliger des <e:pyro>DGT Pyro de zone</e>.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Plonge depuis les airs en concentrant ses pouvoirs Pyro, infligeant des DGT aux ennemis en chemin et des <e:pyro>DGT Pyro de zone</e> à l'impact.

skill.name: Bombe rebondissante
skill.desc: Boiing, boiing ! Klee lance une bombe qui pète de joie ! La bombe rebondit 3 fois et explose à chaque rebond, infligeant des DGT Pyro de zone. Après le 3e rebond, la bombe se divise en plusieurs mines. Les mines explosent après un court délai ou au contact de l'ennemi, infligeant des DGT Pyro de zone. Klee commence avec 2 utilisations disponibles. La Bombe rebondissante est l'amie fidèle de Klee... Elle veut toujours la présenter à tout le monde.

burst.name: Fleur bombardier
burst.desc: Klee s'enflamme ! Invoque une Fleur bombardier qui harcèle les ennemis proches, infligeant des DGT Pyro de zone. Les membres de l'Ordre de Favonius sont convaincus qu'une bonne étoile veille sur Klee... Sinon, comment expliquer qu'elle ne se blesse jamais ?

passives.name: Cadeau explosif
passives.desc:
En infligeant des DGT avec sa compétence élémentaire <k>Bombe rebondissante</k> ou son attaque normale, Klee a 50 % de chances d'obtenir une étincelle explosive, utiliser sa compétence élémentaire <k>Bombe rebondissante</k> ou son déchaînement élémentaire <k>Fleur bombardier</k> lui accordant également une étincelle explosive. Klee peut posséder un maximum de 3 étincelles explosives.
Lorsqu'elle effectue une attaque chargée tout en possédant des étincelles explosives, Klee en consomme une pour déclencher à la place l'attaque chargée spéciale « Frappe boum-boum » ne consommant pas d'endurance et augmentant les DGT infligés de 50 %.

<k>Hexerei : Rituel secret</k>
Pendant la durée de son déchaînement élémentaire <k>Fleur bombardier</k>, la séquence de l'attaque normale de Klee ne se réinitialise pas. De plus, si Klee possède des étincelles explosives lorsqu'elle effectue une attaque normale, le troisième coup de la séquence en consomme une pour déclencher une attaque additionnelle équivalant à une frappe boum-boum sur l'ennemi.

passives.name: Étincelle infinie
passives.desc: Lorsque Klee inflige des DGT CRIT avec des attaques chargées, l'énergie élémentaire de tous les personnages de l'équipe est restaurée de 2 pts.

passives.name: Des trésors partout !
passives.desc: Affiche l'emplacement des <k>produits de Mondstadt</k> sur la mini-carte.

passives.name: Veillée de la sorcière : Magie des étincelles
passives.desc:
Après avoir terminé le <k>devoir de la sorcière « De feuilles d'étincelles »</k>, Klee devient un personnage <k>héxère</k>. Si l'équipe contient au moins 2 personnages héxères, elle bénéficie de l'effet <k>Hexerei : Rituel secret</k> qui améliore les personnages héxères.

<k>Hexerei : Rituel secret</k>
Lorsque Klee inflige des DGT avec une attaque normale, une compétence élémentaire ou un déchaînement élémentaire, elle gagne 1 boum-badge d'une durée de 20 s, chaque type d'attaque pouvant accorder 1 boum-badge existant indépendamment de cette manière. Lorsque Klee possède 1/2/3 boum-badges, son attaque chargée spéciale « Frappe boum-boum » inflige respectivement 115 %/130 %/150 % des DGT d'origine.

constellations.name: Bombardement continu
constellations.desc:
Les attaques et compétences ont une chance de générer des étincelles qui bombardent les ennemis, infligeant 120 % des DGT de <k>Fleur bombardier</k>.
Déclencher cet effet augmente l'ATQ de Klee de 60 % pendant 12 s.

constellations.name: Éclats de bombe
constellations.desc: Toucher des ennemis avec la compétence élémentaire de Klee diminue leur DÉF de 23 % pendant 10 s.

constellations.name: Tout est prêt
constellations.desc: Si Klee quitte le terrain pendant la durée de <k>Fleur bombardier</k> ou si la durée de <k>Fleur bombardier</k> arrive à son terme, une explosion se déclenche, infligeant des <e:pyro>DGT Pyro de zone</e> d'une valeur équivalant à 555 % de l'ATQ. Si Klee est sur le terrain lors du déclenchement de cet effet, les DGT infligés augmentent de 100 %.

constellations.name: À tout feu
constellations.desc:
Klee restaure 3 pts d'énergie élémentaire à tous les personnages de l'équipe (hormis Klee) toutes les 3 s tant que <k>Fleur bombardier</k> est active.
L'activation de <k>Fleur bombardier</k> confère un bonus de <e:pyro>DGT Pyro</e> de 10 % à tous les autres membres de l'équipe et accorde un <e:pyro>bonus de DGT Pyro</e> de 50 % à Klee, le tout pendant 25 s.

<k>Hexerei : Rituel secret</k>
En déclenchant un effet consommant une <k>étincelle explosive</k>, il y a 50 % de chances de ne pas en consommer<k></k>. De plus, tant que <k>Fleur bombardier</k> est active, le premier et le deuxième coup de l'attaque normale de Klee ont 40 % de chances de consommer une étincelle explosive pour déclencher une attaque additionnelle équivalant à une frappe boum-boum sur l'ennemi.
